requirements.quote:
DPLPMTUD [DPLPMTUD] relies on tracking loss or acknowledgment of QUIC
   packets that are carried in PMTU probes.  PMTU probes for DPLPMTUD
   that use the PADDING frame implement "Probing using padding data", as
   defined in Section 4.1 of [DPLPMTUD].
requirements.condition: When a DPLPMTUD PMTU probe uses the PADDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Implement the "Probing using padding data" procedure defined in Section 4.1 of DPLPMTUD.
requirements.why_checkable: A probe containing a PADDING frame can be inspected to determine whether it follows the identified padding-data probing procedure.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints SHOULD set the initial value of BASE_PLPMTU (Section 5.1 of
   [DPLPMTUD]) to be consistent with QUIC's smallest allowed maximum
   datagram size.  The MIN_PLPMTU is the same as the BASE_PLPMTU.
requirements.required_behavior: Set BASE_PLPMTU consistently with QUIC's smallest allowed maximum datagram size.
requirements.why_checkable: The initialized BASE_PLPMTU can be compared with the implementation's smallest allowed QUIC maximum datagram size.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints SHOULD set the initial value of BASE_PLPMTU (Section 5.1 of
   [DPLPMTUD]) to be consistent with QUIC's smallest allowed maximum
   datagram size.  The MIN_PLPMTU is the same as the BASE_PLPMTU.
requirements.condition: When BASE_PLPMTU and MIN_PLPMTU are established.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use different values for MIN_PLPMTU and BASE_PLPMTU.
requirements.why_checkable: The two configured values can be directly compared for equality.

requirements.quote:
QUIC endpoints implementing DPLPMTUD maintain a DPLPMTUD Maximum
   Packet Size (MPS) (Section 4.4 of [DPLPMTUD]) for each combination of
   local and remote IP addresses.  This corresponds to the maximum
   datagram size.
requirements.condition: When a QUIC endpoint implements DPLPMTUD.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain a DPLPMTUD Maximum Packet Size separately for each combination of local and remote IP addresses.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation state can be inspected to verify that every local/remote IP address combination has its own maintained MPS value.

requirements.quote:
QUIC endpoints implementing DPLPMTUD maintain a DPLPMTUD Maximum
   Packet Size (MPS) (Section 4.4 of [DPLPMTUD]) for each combination of
   local and remote IP addresses.  This corresponds to the maximum
   datagram size.
requirements.condition: For each DPLPMTUD MPS maintained by a QUIC endpoint.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the MPS as the maximum datagram size for its local and remote IP address combination.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet-sizing behavior can be checked against the MPS associated with the active local/remote IP address combination.
